name: Nordmende CSG100IX — 100cm Dual-Fuel Range Cooker
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk.
description: The Nordmende CSG100IX is a 100cm dual-fuel range cooker in stainless steel, built around twin fan ovens and a six-burner gas hob with a separate wok burner — plenty of room for family cooking and entertaining. A double grill, generous storage drawer and cast-iron pan supports round it off, and it carries an A energy rating with a 3-year warranty.
features: Twin fan ovens — cook multiple dishes at once
Six gas burners plus a dedicated wok burner
